DDBLI.Step1: 1. Click "Open D&D Beyond" below. It opens a new tab to your campaigns using your current login.
DDBLI.Step2: 2. Pick your campaign, then click into the character you want.
DDBLI.Step3: 3. On that character's page, click the DDB Import bookmarklet (see setup below if you haven't added it).
DDBLI.Step4: 4. Come back here and click "Paste Character Data."
DDBLI.BookmarkletSetup: One-time setup: drag this link to your bookmarks bar: {link}
DDBLI.SecurityNote: The bookmarklet only runs in your own browser tab, using your own D&D Beyond login. It reads one character's data and copies it to your clipboard. Nothing is sent anywhere else.
DDBLI.ImportFailedParse: Clipboard doesn't look like D&D Beyond character data. Did you click the bookmarklet on a character page first?
DDBLI.ImportFailedEmpty: Clipboard is empty. Click the bookmarklet on a D&D Beyond character page first.
DDBLI.ImportFailedClipboard: Couldn't read the clipboard. Your browser may be blocking clipboard access for Foundry — click inside the Foundry window first, then try Paste again.
DDBLI.GMOnly: Only the GM can import D&D Beyond characters.
